timeline.label: FDA posts the leucovorin calcium shortage

explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified VAI 346 days before the shortage posting and a Warning Letter 1007 days before the posting

sentences.text: FDA posted the leucovorin calcium shortage on 2012-01-01 and as of 2026-10-21 it has been on the list for 178 months.
A Warning Letter was issued to Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (FEI 1510690) on 2009-03-30, which was 1007 days before the shortage posting.
An FDA inspection of the same plant ended 2011-01-20 and was classified VAI, 346 days before the shortage posting.
Subsequent inspections of that plant in 2014, 2018, and 2026 were also classified VAI or NAI.
Another registered plant for this product, Cerbios-Pharma SA (FEI 3002808250), received a VAI classification on 2024-03-07.
The rule-based transfer option ranked 1 moves 8 units from Corvale Lakeside (24 days on hand) to Corvale East (7 days on hand), raising East to 8 days on hand.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-6c2e49.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%leucovorin%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%leucovorin%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-409d33.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('33663425-4731-4977-9127-9e59b6b91497', 'cc52077f-5663-4f79-a273-0aecf655e038', '9d0e5356-ff39-4a8e-944c-e808a21ef4b2') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-fa78bc.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%leucovorin%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-7f6560.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%leucovorin%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-53094a.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%leucovorin%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%tablet%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-bf8df3.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3002808250', '1510690') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-4c3a3c.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3002808250', '1510690') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-05433a.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3002808250', '1510690') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('cerbios', 'west ward columbus', 'sagent pharms', 'hikma farmaceutica')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-c0219e.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('cerbios', 'west ward columbus', 'sagent pharms', 'hikma farmaceutica', 'hikma', 'sagent') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%leucovorin%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-0b3718.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00054449705', '00143955201', '25021081310')
